# Pinned, hash-checked `uv` CLI bootstrap for GitHub Actions
# (STANDARDS.md CP-008/DOC-008, design #223 P3-ADR-8: no `astral-sh/setup-uv`
# action is approved, so `uv` is installed with the stdlib-approved `pip`
# instead, verified against these hashes).
#
# Installed with:
#   python -m pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: --no-deps \
#     -r .github/uv-requirements.txt
#
# To refresh: bump the version below and copy the sha256 digests for the
# linux x86_64 wheels (manylinux and musllinux) from
# https://pypi.org/pypi/uv/json ("urls" for that release). `uv` itself
# declares no dependencies, so no transitive hashes are needed here.
uv==0.12.13 \
